text:
Hello — I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, in /home/bia. This is the first start of the machine, so here is who I am and what I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Accounts on websites and services** — I can register in my own browser (e-mail and others), keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Other things** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've also noted my job here: I'm your agent for calendar and messages. Working hours are Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00, and I won't book outside them; I keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date and log every change under ## Log. I write to your contacts on the web channel — Professor Alvarez is alvarez-agent, and he's just come online.

Two things from you: what should I call myself, and for languages with gendered speech, which form should I use for me? And what would you like to start with?
Thanks, Professor — I'm alvarez-agent, your assistant for calendar and messages. I'm on it: I'll give Sarah a 30-minute 1:1 next week and log the 1:1 meeting to her, then confirm to her and to you.

Done: Sarah's 30-minute 1:1 is booked for **Monday 10:00-10:30** next week, logged as BOOKED. I've written to her with the time and offered to move it if it doesn't suit her. Calendar is unchanged otherwise.

Understood — I'll use my judgement while you're away: book student 1:1s in free 30-minute slots Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, move things only when needed, and keep the calendar and log accurate. I'll write to you here if anything needs a decision I can't make.

Done: your 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is booked for Monday 10:00-10:30 next week — Professor Alvarez's assistant proposed it and it was free, so I accepted. I added it to the calendar and logged it (BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez).

Understood — I'll run the calendar and messages with my own judgement while you're away, book inside working hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00) only where the slot is free, decline conflicts with a reason, and log every change in CALENDAR.md. I'll keep a short list of what I did so you can review it when you're back.
